sql: WITH ord AS (SELECT * FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND action='buy' AND created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00'), fl AS (SELECT f.market_ticker, sum(f.quantity) q, sum(COALESCE(f.fee,0)) fee FROM fills f JOIN ord o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id GROUP BY 1), snap AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, COALESCE(quantity_fp,quantity::numeric) qty, realized_pnl FROM positions WHERE market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM ord) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) SELECT '1_live_exchange_realized' k, to_char(COALESCE(sum(s.realized_pnl),0),'FM990.0000')||' settled='||count(*)::text v FROM fl JOIN snap s USING (market_ticker) WHERE s.qty=0 AND s.realized_pnl IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '2_live_tickers_ordered', count(DISTINCT market_ticker)::text FROM ord UNION ALL SELECT '3_live_tickers_filled', count(*)::text FROM fl UNION ALL SELECT '4_live_tickers_unfilled', (SELECT count(DISTINCT market_ticker) FROM ord)::text||' - '||(SELECT count(*) FROM fl)::text UNION ALL SELECT '5_papertrades_Fmmsell10_all', to_char(sum(pnl),'FM990.0000')||' n='||count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND closed_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00' UNION ALL SELECT '6_papertrades_F_on_filled_tickers', to_char(COALESCE(sum(p.pnl),0),'FM990.0000')||' n='||count(*)::text FROM paper_trades p JOIN fl ON fl.market_ticker=p.market_ticker WHERE p.strategy='Fmmsell10' AND p.closed_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00' UNION ALL SELECT '7_papertrades_F_on_UNfilled', to_char(COALESCE(sum(p.pnl),0),'FM990.0000')||' n='||count(*)::text FROM paper_trades p WHERE p.strategy='Fmmsell10' AND p.closed_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00' AND p.market_ticker NOT IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl) UNION ALL SELECT '8_papertrades_twin', to_char(sum(pnl),'FM990.0000')||' n='||count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10_pt4' AND closed_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00' UNION ALL SELECT '9_ticker_overlap_with_E', count(*)::text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM ord INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Emmsell10') z ORDER BY 1
